course_title: Large Language Models: Theoretical Foundations and Practical Applications
topics: Introduction to Attention and Language Models
Advanced Prompt Engineering and Implementing a RAG application
learning_outcomes: Design, implement, and evaluate complex LLM applications in real-world settings.
Gain hands-on experience with transformer architectures, semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents.
Understand cutting-edge methods for deploying LLMs locally and leveraging Knowledge Graphs to enhance LLM-based systems.
